title: Soldier Patrol and Landmines
physics_constraints: soldier patrol speed: 2 m/s along waypoint paths
cyclic patrol: loop back to first waypoint
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) Loading with GLTFLoader + using SkeletonUtils.clone to create 3 soldiers with independent skeletal animations; (2) a waypoint patrol system including looping routes, automatic turning, and switching between Walk/Idle animations; (3) clicking the grid with Raycaster to place landmines; (4) distance detection to trigger explosions; (5) particle explosion effects (generation, outward movement, and disappearance); (6) soldier death animation and removal; (7) complete game state management (victory condition)
